name: asana
description: Asana project management integration. Connects Google Antigravity to Asana's V2 MCP server (https://mcp.asana.com/v2/mcp) to create and manage tasks, search projects, update assignments, and track progress. Requires a one-time setup of your own Asana OAuth app — run /asana-setup after installing.
